name: vscode-d2-markdown
description: Render D2 diagrams in VS Code's built-in Markdown preview.

d2.theme.markdownDescription: Light-mode D2 theme ID. See the [D2 themes](https://d2lang.com/tour/themes) list. `0` is Neutral Default.

d2.darkTheme.markdownDescription: Dark-mode D2 theme ID, used when the VS Code color theme is dark. `200` is Dark Mauve.

d2.layout.description: Layout engine used to render diagrams.

d2.sketch.description: Render diagrams in hand-drawn sketch mode.

d2.pad.description: Pixels of padding around the rendered diagram.

d2.center.description: Center the diagram inside its viewbox.

d2.renderTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for a single diagram to render before giving up and showing an error block.

d2.compileOptions.markdownDescription: Extra options passed to D2's `compile()`, using D2's own option names. See [CompileOptions](https://github.com/terrastruct/d2/blob/master/d2js/index.d.ts). Overrides the dedicated `d2.*` settings above; `d2.renderOptions` overrides this, and a per-block option in the fence info string overrides both. `fontRegular`, `fontItalic`, `fontBold` and `fontSemibold` are not supported: font data cannot be expressed in settings.json.

themeID.description: D2 theme ID. Overrides d2.theme/d2.darkTheme, so diagrams stop following the editor theme.

center.description: Center the diagram in its viewbox.

scale.description: Scale the output; 1 turns off fitting the SVG to its container.

forceAppendix.description: Add an appendix for tooltips and links.

target.description: Board to render, e.g. "layers.x.*". Requires animateInterval to be greater than 0 for multi-board output.

animateInterval.description: Milliseconds between boards when several are packaged into one animated SVG.

ascii.description: Render ASCII art instead of an SVG.

asciiMode.description: Character set used by ASCII rendering.

d2.renderOptions.markdownDescription: Extra options passed to D2's `render()`, using D2's own option names. See [RenderOptions](https://github.com/terrastruct/d2/blob/master/d2js/index.d.ts). Takes precedence over `d2.compileOptions` and the settings above; a per-block option in the fence info string still wins. `salt`, `noXMLTag` and `darkThemeID` are set by the extension and are ignored here: diagrams sharing a preview document, and following the editor theme, depend on their values. The font options are ignored as well, since font data cannot be expressed in settings.json.

themeID.description: D2 theme ID. Overrides d2.theme/d2.darkTheme, so diagrams stop following the editor theme.

center.description: Center the diagram in its viewbox.

scale.description: Scale the output; 1 turns off fitting the SVG to its container.

forceAppendix.description: Add an appendix for tooltips and links.

target.description: Board to render, e.g. "layers.x.*". Requires animateInterval to be greater than 0 for multi-board output.

animateInterval.description: Milliseconds between boards when several are packaged into one animated SVG.

ascii.description: Render ASCII art instead of an SVG.

asciiMode.description: Character set used by ASCII rendering.

d2.syncWaitMs.markdownDescription: How long the Markdown preview may wait for a diagram that is not cached yet, in milliseconds. Diagrams are rendered ahead of time as you type, so this is only a fallback; anything slower falls back to a placeholder that is filled in as soon as the render finishes. Set to `0` to never wait.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && npm run verify && npm run verify:service
